text: The data breach described has a severe impact due to the highly sensitive nature of the compromised information. The exposure of medical histories and treatment information violates patient privacy and confidentiality, which are critical in healthcare settings. Furthermore, the inclusion of patient names and health insurance details significantly elevates the risk of financial harm. As noted, this combination of personal and financial data creates a high potential for identity theft and insurance fraud, directly threatening the security and well-being of the 200,000 affected individuals.
